integrity: Proof reduces all complex coefficient phases and positive radii to exact polynomial sign and rational isolation certificates. Ordinary self-review only; no independent validation or external certification.
limitations: The constant is sharp only for Gaussian Fock polynomials of degree at most two; no claim of the unrestricted sharp constant or higher-degree extremizers. Relevant unindexed work could overlap.
title: Sharp quadratic coercivity constant for the Gaussian Fock squaring map
